verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents sharing folders with anyone, including people without accounts, and granting viewer-only access. Password-protected files add a layer of access control. That covers the organized shared folders and view-only link parts of a lightweight data room. missing for 10: documented download controls (disable or restrict downloads on links), access visibility or viewer analytics for diligence (who viewed what), and independent or hands-on corroboration of a data-room workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a lightweight data room — organized shared folders with view-only links, download controls, and access visibility for diligence

citations.quote: Dropbox makes it easy to share files and folders with anyone, even if they don’t have a Dropbox account.
You want people to have viewer access only
Changes to the contents inside a shared folder are synced with members of that folder almost instantly.
